{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment <= 0.0) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows persistent downward drift and true outcome is below model.",
    "Increase forecast if true outcome is significantly below model and sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.0), indicating potential rebound.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if model is 10%+ above or below 30-day moving average of true outcomes, adjust toward it.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly higher than model 3-5 days after a spike, reduce forecast for next period.",
    "Avoid overshoot after spikes: if model peaks sharply after a spike, cap forecast at 10% below peak for next 3 days.",
    "If sentiment is positive and model is consistently below true outcome, increase forecast by 5-10% for next period."
  ]
}
